hypothesis: Current accounting can reconcile candidate versions, gate-state updates and mechanical studies without turning translations, repairs, review groups or schema checks into independent semantic/model samples.
rules: Deduplicate review-state transitions for the same exact bilingual candidate bytes.
Keep SQLX original and corrected candidate as separate version records but one related topic/family.
Do not count Zod pending/recovered statuses as multiple inference attempts.
Separate deterministic/manual chapters, helper maintenance and historical neural-contribution outputs.
A zero new-model denominator gives null rate, never zero-percent failure or success.
Use actual per-record outcomes to recompute mechanical study numerators/denominators before trusting summary metadata.
Semantic-blind controls and valid-paraphrase refusals retain their separate populations.
AST byte/field/compile outcomes are representation evidence, not atomic factual accuracy or runtime execution.
Each metric includes population, method, baseline and confidence limitations.
source_current: Research receipts in current campaign only; historical method catalog linked unchanged.
